messages:
rachael: quick thread to capture a few follow-ups from today's all-hands re: hiring & org changes. putting answers here so folks have one source.
zoe: thanks! can you confirm whether headcount will be pooled centrally or stay with product lines?
rachael: short answer: hybrid. critical roles stay with product lines; a small central pool (~5% of headcount) will exist for strategic hires and urgent coverage.
cal: what about a swap window? managers asked if they can swap headcount between teams without exec sign-off.
lina: managers can request a 30-day swap (temporary reassign) via the Talent Marketplace form. permanent swaps need Finance + People Ops sign-off.
matt: timeline: central-pool policy and swap form live by EOD Friday. Finance will process permanent reallocation requests in 3 business days for priority cases.
zoe: will we have a skills-tagging system so Talent can surface matches for internal moves?
lina: yes 1 Talent will publish a short skills taxonomy and enable a "skills" tag in Workday so managers can search potential transferees. Talent will run a one-week internal matching sprint after launch.
rachael: note on region rules: moves that impact visa sponsorship or cross-country payroll require Legal + People Ops sign-off and longer lead times. flag early.
cal: any change to EEO or interview guidelines during the shuffle? want to avoid bias in rapid moves.
lina: no change to EEO policies. Interview/offer guidance remains standard. we'll run a short training drop (10-min video) for recruiters/managers on fair evaluation during high-mobility periods.
ops-bot: doc-publish: "people-ops/central-pool-and-swap-policy.md" at 2499990048
zoe: last tiny ask: can we get a one-pager for ICs that explains the talent marketplace and what opting in means?
rachael: yes 1 People Ops will post an IC one-pager + FAQ and a short Loom demo of the marketplace. will share links here when live. :thumbsup:
__notes: All-hands follow-up: hybrid central pool, swap window, talent marketplace skills tags, timeline for docs, region/visa rules, EEO reminder, and a bot note for doc publish. Slack-style concise messages.
